name: @repo/pi-agent-ext-wayfind
description: Pi-native port of Matt Pocock's decision-chain skill suite — grilling (relentless one-question-at-a-time interview), grill-me-with-docs (grilling + domain-modeling: writes CONTEXT.md glossary + ADRs inline), domain-modeling, wayfinder (chart a huge effort as a local-markdown map of decision tickets), to-spec, and to-tickets. Ships as a Layer-3 Pi extension: CSO-compliant skills + slash commands that kick off grilling/wayfinding sessions, and hands off resolved decisions -> a task_plan.md seed. Pure TypeScript, no Python, no shell scripts.

scripts.test: bun run check && bun run build && bun run test:unit
